7.5
Support for Additional File Formats
Future versions can extend support to additional document formats including:
• Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx)
• Excel Spreadsheets (.xlsx)
• HTML Documents
• Markdown Files
• EPUB Books
This enhancement would make the application suitable for a wider range of research
materials.
7.6
Advanced Search Features
The semantic search engine can be enhanced by incorporating:
• Hybrid Search (Keyword + Semantic Search)
• Metadata-based Filtering
• Date-wise Search
• Author-wise Search
• Research Topic Classification
These features would significantly improve retrieval accuracy and user experience.
